topography.project_purpose: Yield Protocol is a DeFi lending platform that enables users to deposit assets into yield-generating vaults and pools. It provides fixed-rate and variable-rate lending markets, supported by adapters for external protocols and oracles for price feeds.
topography.relationship_narrative: The yoGateway registry links yoVaults to Onchain Adapters, enabling vaults to interact with external protocols. Yield Protocol pools operate independently but share the same governance and oracle infrastructure as the vaults.
